finding.title: Fix WizardCustomStep2 Slider crash when a 5th custom review round defaults delayDays to 90 (slider max is 60)
finding.why: CustomRoundState.withDefault(4) seeds the 5th review round's delayDays at 90, but _RoundTimingCard's delay Slider is capped at max:60. WizardCustomStep1's own slider allows chazarahRounds up to 5; advancing to WizardCustomStep2 renders all 5 timing cards immediately (ListView.builder over the full list), so the 5th Slider is constructed with value:90 outside [1,60]. Verified empirically with a throwaway flutter-test render: 'Failed assertion: ... `value >= min && value <= max`: Value 90.0 is not between minimum 1.0 and maximum 60.0' (package:flutter/src/material/slider.dart) — this fires in every debug/profile build and in `flutter test`, making the custom-review-builder path unusable for anyone who picks 5 rounds. No test anywhere sets chazarahRounds above 3 (line 683 is the batch's own highest), so nothing catches it.
finding.recommendation: Clamp the Slider's max to 90 (adjust divisions accordingly) or clamp state.delayDays when building the Slider's value; add a WizardCustomStep2 test that renders all 5 rounds (chazarahRounds=5) and asserts tester.takeException() is null.
acceptance_criteria: Slider value stays within [min,max] for every roundIndex 0..4 CustomRoundState.withDefault can produce
a regression test renders WizardCustomStep2 with 5 rounds and asserts no exception is thrown
